name: Watch manufacturers
note: Full category = every Wikidata item returned by discovery_sparql (industry horology or watchmaking, or product watch, or instance of watch manufacturing company) that has an English Wikipedia article. No hand exclusions. Items with a dissolution date in Wikidata are shown and flagged, not removed. Seiko and Swatch are added by hand because Wikidata does not classify them as watch companies; that addition is stated on the page.
discovery_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?sitelinks WHERE { { ?item wdt:P452 wd:Q41767 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P452 wd:Q63346664 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P1056 wd:Q178794 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q136094627 . } ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 400

manual_additions.label: Seiko
manual_additions.reason: Not classified as a watch company in Wikidata (no industry/product statement); obviously belongs.

highlight.reason: Brands sold in the US by Citizen Watch of America.
highlight.missing_note: Also sold by Citizen Watch of America, but not in this category: neither has an English Wikipedia article that Wikidata classifies as a watch company.

inclusion_rule: Only brands that have customers, business or consumer, are included. Companies that Wikidata records as dissolved have no current customers and are left out.

exclude.Q1496822: Geneva Seal: a certification, not a business with customers
exclude.Q138307980: The Geneva School of Watchmaking: a school, not a brand with customers

intro: When watch customers ask AI about a brand or the category, AI can lean heavily on Wikipedia and Wikidata. BrandTabulator ranks every brand in the category by how complete and current its record is. It is refreshed every week, so bookmark this tab.

Of course, there are many sources that AI relies on. My work is to Diagnose the responses, Investigate the sources they credit, and Prescribe what can be done to improve the visibility and accuracy of brand descriptions in AI (DIP). To learn more, contact Michael@MichaelQuinn.ai
